For your visit to Paris on November 15th, I recommend the restaurant "Le Baratin" for authentic French cuisine. It is the top-rated spot among French restaurants I found, with a rating of 4.8. It offers a cozy bistro atmosphere with delicious homestyle cooking and a daily changing menu based on fresh market ingredients. Its address is 3 Rue Jouye-Rouve, 75020 Paris, France.

For your hotel stay within your budget of 500 euros (assuming two meals included), I recommend "Le Marais Boutique." It has a price range starting from 120 euros to 180 euros, making it fit your budget comfortably. The address of this hotel is 12 Rue des Archives, 75004 Paris, France.

If you want me to proceed with reservations or need more details, please let me know!
